note: Chip Battle: the glade's take B sound turned up for the fight: pulse lead over the flute, chip arpeggios, a triangle bass driving eighths, battle drums.

dive.note: Dive: a chromatic run tumbling down two octaves, three hits on D minor, then a flourish up to a held high A.

flash.note: Flash: high As flickering an octave apart like the screen flashing, arpeggios sweeping down, then the band charging on A.

note: Chip + Brass: the same tune with a brass section under the pulse lead, a string ostinato and orchestral stabs, the chip still on top.
